name: omniperf-bench-runs
description: A collection of benchmark run records produced by the OmniPerf evaluation tooling, capturing model/task run metadata and per-run metrics. It aggregates performance measurements (accuracy, latency, resource usage) across diverse tasks and models to support analysis and comparison. The dataset is intended for tracking, reproducing, and aggregating benchmarking outcomes rather than as a single-task evaluation corpus.
evaluation_method: varied — task-specific metrics (accuracy, F1, BLEU) plus runtime/latency and resource metrics
general_score_metric: task-specific metrics (e.g., accuracy, F1) combined with runtime/latency metrics
reputation: Utility dataset for ML benchmarking and MLOps users; modest adoption within tooling/benchmarking communities.
